name: Morning Flow
summary: Breath-led vinyasa that builds heat slowly. Sun salutations, standing poses, a long rest.
detail: The class most people start their week with. We link each move to a breath, build to a few standing balances, and finish with ten quiet minutes. Modifications are offered for every pose.
imageAlt: A woman holding a strong high plank on a mat in a white studio

name: Strong Flow
summary: Longer holds, arm balances and inversions for people who want to work.
detail: Faster pacing and longer holds, with time set aside each week to practise one arm balance or inversion step by step. Come after a few months of regular practice.
imageAlt: A man balancing on his hands in a side crow pose on a red mat

name: Slow & Yin
summary: Floor-based poses held for three to five minutes. Bolsters, blankets, very little talking.
detail: Mostly seated and lying down, with props doing much of the work. Good for tight hips, long desk days and anyone who sleeps badly. Nothing here is hard, though some of it is surprisingly deep.
imageAlt: A woman resting in child's pose on a pink mat, arms stretched long

name: Gentle Basics
summary: The foundations, taught slowly. Chairs available. Our most popular class for new students.
detail: We take four or five poses a week and learn them properly — where your feet go, what to feel, what to skip. Chairs and blocks are set out for anyone who wants them.
imageAlt: A smiling older woman stretching forward in a seated pose during a group class

name: Prenatal
summary: For every trimester. Hip openers, gentle strength and breathing you can take into labour.
detail: Taught by a certified prenatal teacher. Every pose has a version for each trimester, and there is always time to talk. Welcome from twelve weeks with your midwife or doctor's okay.
imageAlt: Two pregnant women balancing in tree pose side by side

name: Breath & Stillness
summary: Twenty minutes of breathing practice, twenty of guided sitting. Cushions provided.
detail: A short, quiet class on the breath: counted breathing, alternate-nostril breathing and a guided sit. Useful on its own, and a good way to end a long day.
imageAlt: A woman sitting cross-legged with her eyes closed in soft window light
